## LmdbEnv.(constructor)

Construct a new LmdbEnv and open the underlying LMDB environment.

**Signature:**

```typescript
constructor(options: ILmdbEnvOptions);
```

## Parameters

<table><thead><tr><th>

Parameter


</th><th>

Type


</th><th>

</th></tr></thead>
<tbody><tr><td>

options


</td><td>

[ILmdbEnvOptions](./lmdb.ilmdbenvoptions.md)


</td><td>

Env configuration. Supports the full set of LMDB `open()` parameters via [ILmdbEnvOptions](./lmdb.ilmdbenvoptions.md)<!-- -->.


</td></tr>
</tbody></table>

## Remarks

Construction opens the env immediately. The `path` is required and flows through to lmdb's native `open()`<!-- -->. No explicit `open()` call is needed. Defaults: `mapSize` = 4 GB (`4 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024` bytes), `maxDbs` = 128.

## Example


```typescript
// Default — LMDB native msgpack
const env = new LmdbEnv({ path: "./data" });

// Human-readable JSON storage
const env = new LmdbEnv({ path: "./data", encoding: "json" });

// With compression + custom page size
const env = new LmdbEnv({
  path: "./data",
  compression: true,
  pageSize: 8192
});
```
